messages:
kai (Design): Uploaded new tablet-first mock for the private/VPC preflight. Main changes: explicit "air-gapped" toggle, per-probe short impact lines, and a tiny contextual 'diagnostic sandbox' link for safe retries. Screenshot in thread.

meera (PM): Love the sandbox idea. Two asks: (1) copy for failures should say exact impact (eg 'Blocks agent install'); (2) make the air-gapped toggle explain last-mile networking implications in one line.

drew (Eng): For the sandbox: it should run checks against a simulated control-plane endpoint so we don't hammer customer infra. We'll surface a small disclaimer and require an opt-in. Technical note: sandbox runs as a separate job and won't be logged to main audit stream.

violet (DevEx): UX nit: sandbox CTA should be keyboard-focusable and have an aria-dialog-lite pattern (slide-in, not modal). Also add a confirmed success toast and aria-live announcement.

a11y-bot: Automated flag: current pale orange fails AA contrast (3.0:1). Recommend darker amber or swap to an outlined badge + text. Also check toggle label contrast.

kai (Design): I'll darken amber and add an outline variant for badges. For the air-gapped toggle microcopy: "Air-gapped (no outbound to internet) 13 Explain" where Explain opens a short panel describing KMS/HSM and vendor doc links.

meera (PM): Wording for disabled probes when air-gapped: show "Not applicable in air-gapped mode" instead of 'Skipped' to reduce confusion. Also add a tooltip: "You chose air-gapped; these checks are intentionally disabled."

drew (Eng): Implementation: probe rows will show shape + text + color; shape (circle/triangle/stop) helps color-blind users. For dynamic changes set aria-live=polite and include the probe name in announcements. Example: "SSH probe: Not applicable in air-gapped mode".

violet (DevEx): Copy-button details: single-keyboard focusable icon with aria-label like "Copy SSH debug command" and an aria-live region announcing "SSH command copied". Also visual confirmation for 2s.

a11y-bot: Quick re-check: adding shapes fine, but ensure SVGs have role=presentation if decorative and text fallbacks exist. Also focus ring contrast should be >= 3:1.

kai (Design): I'll update mocks: darker amber, outline badges, new toggle copy, and sandbox CTA with confirmation flow. I'll annotate keyboard order and copy states.

meera (PM): Acceptance checklist draft:
- air-gapped toggle has explanatory text and Explain panel
- disabled probes show "Not applicable in air-gapped mode"
- status uses shape + color + clear label
- amber meets 4.5:1 or is outlined+text fallback
- sandbox runs opt-in, non-production, and shows toast + aria-live
- copy buttons keyboard accessible and announce success

drew (Eng): I'll add unit tests for sandbox opt-in and aria-live announcements. Also will make sure retries are debounced and audit logs label sandbox runs differently.

violet (DevEx): I'll run a small VoiceOver + NVDA pass once mocks are in PR. Can someone sanity-check with mac VoiceOver?

kai (Design): I'll push the updated frames in ~1hr and tag this thread. Thanks! :sparkles:
